title: Red-green never reports a plain YES for code that is only missing on HEAD
assertion: When a proposed test fails on the last commit only because the code it tests does not exist there, red-green marks the answer as new code and says so, with a hint for the reviewer; a test that fails on behavior the last commit really has is a plain yes that quotes the failure.

origin.text: prompt: "yes, start part 1 and propose the rules too". Promised in ADR-20261013-a5d3 ("To be proposed").
